## Installation

- Research package from source: `pip install -e ".[dev]"` (Python 3.12+, PyTorch 2.4+).
- GUI wheel: download from https://github.com/alshahia/upscale_anime/releases/tag/v0.2.0-preview, then `pip install anime_upscaler_gui-0.2.0-py3-none-any.whl` in a fresh virtual environment; run `anime-upscaler-gui --self-check`.
- No model weights are bundled with the wheel; ffmpeg/ffprobe must be installed for video.

## Usage

- Train: `anime-sr train --config configs/base.yaml`
- Infer: `anime-sr infer --checkpoint checkpoints/model_best.pt --input ./input_images --output ./output --scale 4`
- Agent/agent-friendly summaries: [../AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [../llms.txt](../llms.txt).
- Tests: `pytest` and `python -m mkdocs build --strict`.
